parameters.name: ApprovalAction
parameters.description:
The approval action. Valid values:

- Agree: approves the request.

- Deny: rejects the request.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The idempotency token. We recommend that you use a UUID.

parameters.name: NewExpiration
parameters.description: The modified authorization expiration time. The value is a millisecond-level timestamp.

parameters.name: ProcessInstanceId
parameters.description: The flow instance ID. Both new and legacy Security Center approval orders are supported.
